fields.label: Strategy Key
fields.description: Stable machine identifier a client pins against, e.g. 'london_breakout'. Never renamed once published — a rename would orphan every Forex User Strategy row pointing at it.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: One-paragraph plain-language description shown in the catalog. Read by users deciding what to run with real money — say what it does and when it trades, not how good it is.

fields.label: Minimum Subscription Tier
fields.description: The tier a subscription must hold to RUN this strategy. Browsing the catalog is free at every tier — see rforex.entitlements. An unset value resolves to 'standard', never to free.

fields.label: Listed In Catalog
fields.description: Unchecking removes the strategy from the catalog for new users. It does NOT stop anybody already running it — that is what blocking a version does, and it is deliberately a separate, louder action.
